evals.prompt: Do a security review of this module and record review.md with a verdict and findings.
evals.expected_output: A 'changes' verdict with a finding flagging the SQL injection (location, severity, parameterized-query fix), written as a review.md handoff with a security lens.
assertions: The review flags the SQL injection with a concrete location and a parameterized-query fix
The injection finding carries a blocker/major severity and drives the verdict to 'changes'
The output is a review handoff (type/target/iteration/verdict/findings); no code is modified

evals.prompt: Security-review this small, input-validated, parameterized data-access change before merge.
evals.expected_output: An 'approve' verdict with no blocking findings (at most nits) — no vulnerabilities invented on safe code.
assertions: The verdict is 'approve' for the safe change
No blocker- or major-severity vulnerability is invented on the secure code
The review does not modify any files

component.purpose: Phase workflow: a dedicated deep security review of a component/design/change (threat surface, authz, secrets, dependencies, input handling) into a review handoff with a security lens. Delegates to the security-engineer role; gated at Tier-1 (routing), with finding quality covered by that role's Tier-2. Distinct from code-review's per-diff security aspect.

should_trigger: Do a security review of this service
Is this code secure? Review it for security issues
should_not_trigger: Review this diff for correctness and style before merge
Cut a release and write the changelog
